name: Zooplankton
description: Small drifting and weakly swimming animals grazed by filter-feeding fishes. Functional group aggregating the source's zooplankton compartment - branchiopod crustaceans, copepods and rotifers (classes Branchiopoda, Copepoda, Digononta and Monogononta) - measured together; it feeds on phytoplankton and periphyton.
